title: UI Element
description: A UI element definition in a Minecraft Bedrock UI screen file. UI elements define the visual and interactive components of Minecraft's user interface.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of UI element. Determines how the element is rendered and behaves.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: The renderer to use for custom element types. Examples include 'hud_player_renderer', 'inventory_item_renderer', etc.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: The rendering layer for this element. Higher values render on top of lower values.

size.title: Size
size.description: The size of the UI element. Can be specified as [width, height] where each can be a number (pixels), percentage string ('100%'), or special value ('fill', '100%c', '100%cm').

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: The offset of the UI element from its anchor position. Specified as [x, y] in pixels.

min_size.title: Minimum Size
min_size.description: The minimum size constraints for the UI element.

max_size.title: Maximum Size
max_size.description: The maximum size constraints for the UI element.

anchor_from.title: Anchor From
anchor_from.description: The anchor point on the parent element from which this element is positioned.

anchor_to.title: Anchor To
anchor_to.description: The anchor point on this element used for positioning.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: The orientation for stack panels, determining the direction children are laid out.

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: The texture path for image elements. Relative to the resource pack textures folder.

uv.title: UV Coordinates
uv.description: UV coordinates for texture mapping, specified as [u, v].

uv_size.title: UV Size
uv_size.description: The size of the UV region to sample from the texture.

color.title: Color
color.description: The color tint applied to the element, specified as [r, g, b] with values 0.0-1.0.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: The opacity of the element, from 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (opaque).

visible.title: Visible
visible.description: Whether this element is visible by default.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this element is enabled and can be interacted with.

ignored.title: Ignored
ignored.description: If true, this element is ignored during layout and rendering.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text content for label elements. Can include localization keys.

text_alignment.title: Text Alignment
text_alignment.description: The horizontal alignment of text within a label.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Whether to render a shadow behind text.

font_type.title: Font Type
font_type.description: The font to use for text rendering.

font_size.title: Font Size
font_size.description: The size of the font for text rendering.

font_scale_factor.title: Font Scale Factor
font_scale_factor.description: A multiplier for the font size.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description:
Child elements contained within this element.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_.:@]+ (object)

[a-zA-Z0-9_.:@]+.title: Child Element
[a-zA-Z0-9_.:@]+.description: A child UI element. The key is the element name, optionally with @base_element syntax for inheritance.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description:
Data bindings that connect UI element properties to game data.

Properties:
• binding_name (string)
• binding_name_override (string)
• binding_type (enum)
• binding_collection_name (string)
• binding_condition (enum)
• source_control_name (string)
• source_property_name (string)
• target_property_name (string)

binding_name.title: Binding Name
binding_name.description: The name of the data source to bind to (e.g., '#player_name').

binding_name_override.title: Binding Name Override
binding_name_override.description: The property on the UI element to bind the value to.

binding_collection_name.title: Binding Collection Name
binding_collection_name.description: The name of the collection when using collection bindings.

binding_condition.title: Binding Condition
binding_condition.description: When the binding should be evaluated.

source_control_name.title: Source Control Name
source_control_name.description: The name of the source control for view bindings.

source_property_name.title: Source Property Name
source_property_name.description: The property name on the source control.

target_property_name.title: Target Property Name
target_property_name.description: The property name on the target element.

button_mappings.title: Button Mappings
button_mappings.description:
Mappings from input buttons to actions.

Properties:
• from_button_id (string)
• to_button_id (string)
• mapping_type (enum)
• input_mode_condition (enum)

from_button_id.title: From Button ID
from_button_id.description: The input button that triggers the action.

input_mode_condition.title: Input Mode Condition
input_mode_condition.description: The input mode required for this mapping.

anims.title: Animations
anims.description: Animation references to apply to this element.

animation_reset_name.title: Animation Reset Name
animation_reset_name.description: The name of the animation state to reset to.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description:
Variable definitions for conditional logic.

Properties:
• requires (boolean)

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: The condition that must be met for this variable to be active.

clips_children.title: Clips Children
clips_children.description: Whether child elements are clipped to this element's bounds.

allow_clipping.title: Allow Clipping
allow_clipping.description: Whether this element can be clipped by parent elements.

propagate_alpha.title: Propagate Alpha
propagate_alpha.description: Whether alpha transparency is propagated to child elements.

grid_rescaling_type.title: Grid Rescaling Type
grid_rescaling_type.description: How the grid resizes its cells.

grid_item_template.title: Grid Item Template
grid_item_template.description: The template element to use for grid items.

grid_dimension_binding.title: Grid Dimension Binding
grid_dimension_binding.description: The binding for determining grid dimensions.

collection_name.title: Collection Name
collection_name.description: The name of the collection to use for grid or stack panel items.

factory.title: Factory
factory.description: The factory configuration for dynamic element creation.

focus_enabled.title: Focus Enabled
focus_enabled.description: Whether this element can receive focus.

focus_change_up.title: Focus Change Up
focus_change_up.description: The element to focus when navigating up.

focus_change_down.title: Focus Change Down
focus_change_down.description: The element to focus when navigating down.

focus_change_left.title: Focus Change Left
focus_change_left.description: The element to focus when navigating left.

focus_change_right.title: Focus Change Right
focus_change_right.description: The element to focus when navigating right.

tts_ignore_count.title: TTS Ignore Count
tts_ignore_count.description: Whether to ignore this element when counting for text-to-speech.

tts_skip_message.title: TTS Skip Message
tts_skip_message.description: Whether to skip this element in text-to-speech narration.

tts_control_type_order_priority.title: TTS Control Type Order Priority
tts_control_type_order_priority.description: The priority for ordering elements in text-to-speech.

consume_event.title: Consume Event
consume_event.description: Whether input events are consumed by this element.

always_handle_pointer.title: Always Handle Pointer
always_handle_pointer.description: Whether pointer events are always handled by this element.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: Whether this element acts as a modal overlay.

prevent_touch_input.title: Prevent Touch Input
prevent_touch_input.description: Whether touch input is blocked by this element.

locked_control.title: Locked Control
locked_control.description: The control to display when this element is locked.

slider_steps.title: Slider Steps
slider_steps.description: The number of discrete steps in a slider.

slider_select_on_hover.title: Slider Select On Hover
slider_select_on_hover.description: Whether the slider value changes on hover.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Maximum character length for text input elements.

text_box_name.title: Text Box Name
text_box_name.description: The name identifier for a text box.

place_holder_text.title: Placeholder Text
place_holder_text.description: Placeholder text shown when an input is empty.

virtual_keyboard_buffer_control.title: Virtual Keyboard Buffer Control
virtual_keyboard_buffer_control.description: Whether this input uses a virtual keyboard buffer.

nine_slice_buttom.title: Nine Slice Bottom
nine_slice_buttom.description: The bottom size for nine-slice image rendering.

nine_slice_top.title: Nine Slice Top
nine_slice_top.description: The top size for nine-slice image rendering.

nine_slice_left.title: Nine Slice Left
nine_slice_left.description: The left size for nine-slice image rendering.

nine_slice_right.title: Nine Slice Right
nine_slice_right.description: The right size for nine-slice image rendering.

tiled.title: Tiled
tiled.description: Whether the texture is tiled when rendering.

grayscale.title: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Whether the element is rendered in grayscale.

keep_ratio.title: Keep Ratio
keep_ratio.description: Whether to maintain aspect ratio when scaling.

bilinear.title: Bilinear
bilinear.description: Whether to use bilinear filtering for textures.

scroll_speed.title: Scroll Speed
scroll_speed.description: The speed of scrolling in scroll views.

scrollbar_touch_button.title: Scrollbar Touch Button
scrollbar_touch_button.description: Whether the scrollbar responds to touch.

jump_to_bottom_on_update.title: Jump To Bottom On Update
jump_to_bottom_on_update.description: Whether to auto-scroll to bottom when content updates.

scrollbar_box.title: Scrollbar Box
scrollbar_box.description: Reference to the scrollbar box element.

scrollbar_track.title: Scrollbar Track
scrollbar_track.description: Reference to the scrollbar track element.

scroll_view_port.title: Scroll View Port
scroll_view_port.description: Reference to the scroll viewport element.

scroll_content.title: Scroll Content
scroll_content.description: Reference to the scrollable content element.

scroll_box_and_track_panel.title: Scroll Box And Track Panel
scroll_box_and_track_panel.description: Reference to the panel containing scrollbar box and track.
